result.description: Sales-focused CRM and pipeline management platform for managing deals, contacts, leads and activities.
result.auth_detail: REST API supports OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow (required for Marketplace apps; tokens from oauth.pipedrive.com, Bearer access token, refresh tokens) and a per-user personal API token (sent as api_token / x-api-token) for single-account use.
result.access_detail: Developer sandbox account via a signup form gives Developer Hub access; testing works only for sandbox users. Private apps can be shared with any company via direct install link without review. Public Marketplace listing needs app approval (up to ~21 business days). Personal API tokens work in any account where admin permits API use. Sandbox pricing not stated; pricing page was 403, so plan-gating of API unverified.
result.api_notes: REST API v1 and v2 with OpenAPI specs; about 50 endpoint groups (Activities, Deals, Leads, Persons, Organizations, Products, Pipelines, Projects, Users, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0). JSON output. Official Node.js and PHP clients.
result.blocker: Public multi-tenant OAuth app needs Pipedrive Marketplace app approval for listing (private apps shareable by install link); sandbox-account request needed. API-token auth works immediately for single accounts.

evidence.quote: Authorization via OAuth 2.0 is a well-known and stable way to get fine-grained access to an API.
Using OAuth 2.0 is necessary for developing apps that are available in the Pipedrive Marketplace.
The API token must be provided in the x-api-token header for all requests, for example:
To be published on the Marketplace, your app needs to pass our app approval process.
Submitting the app is unnecessary if it's only used internally.
Fill in the form here to get access to your developer sandbox account!
This API uses a JSON format for output and is capable of handling CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) requests.
Pipedrive MCP is built and maintained by Pipedrive, requires no coding, and works with real-time CRM data.
Pipedrive is an official connector in Claude and ChatGPT.
